validity.researcher_notes: route_integrity read a 0.33 ratio (170 km drawn against 516 km stated). RESOLVED as a scope mismatch, not a length error: the sourced 516 km is the whole Rostov–Taganrog–Zhdanov system, while GEM's row is named Taganrog–Mariupol–Berdyansk and its geometry draws only that partial corridor (169.7 km measured). Zhdanov is the Soviet name for Mariupol. The row conflates a system-level figure with a partial corridor — the same motif the system-level-values escalation describes, appearing here as an under-drawn route rather than a restated capacity.
